# Important

Please confirm that you:

* read the [contributing section](https://github.com/M66B/FairEmail#user-content-contributing)
* read the [get support section](https://github.com/M66B/FairEmail/blob/master/FAQ.md#user-content-get-support)
* agree to [the license and the copyright](https://github.com/M66B/FairEmail#user-content-license)

AI Contribution Policy

* No generative AI content: Contributions containing code, documentation, or issue descriptions generated by LLMs or generative AI tools are not accepted.
* AI-assisted bug hunting: Using AI-based static analysis, fuzzing, or diagnostic tools to identify bugs or security vulnerabilities is permitted.
* Mandatory human intervention: All resulting bug reports, patches, and pull requests must be written, verified, and fully understood by a human contributor. Automated submissions or AI co-authorship are not allowed.

Thanks for your intention to contribute to the project!
